title: Emergency Preparedness Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=radio:test) OR (index=personal sourcetype=gobag:inventory)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="radio:test","primary",sourcetype="gobag:inventory","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from radio:test and gobag:inventory to see whether two emergency preparedness feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `radio:test` and `gobag:inventory` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main emergency preparedness data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
